entities.summary: Laura Almerich Santacreu was a classical Spanish guitarist from Barcelona. She is remembered in particular for accompanying the successful Catalan-language singer Lluís Llach since he embarked on his career in the late 1960s. As a result, she was closely associated with the Catalan Nova Cançó movement. Llach dedicated two songs to her: "Laura" (1977) and "Roses blanques". Laura Almerich i Santacreu was a composers & musicians from Barcelona (1940-07-03, Barcelona–2019-06-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
